notes: SCF itself carries 13 designations across 9 issuers (US, GB, EU, CH, AU, CA, NZ, UA, MC) including OFAC SDN; Tradeverifyd Score 257. tia_quick_check reports screening status 'not_screened': the designations are platform-attached records, not the output of a settled screen.

16 of the 20 owned subsidiaries have annotation_count 0 despite the sanctioned parent: SOVCOMFLOT (UK) LTD, Dafne Line Shipping, Albus Shipping, Boreray Shipping, Serafina Enterprises, Headliner Maritime, Ensay Shipping, Purposeful Corporation, Pabbay Shipping, Global Challenge Shipping, Scalpay Shipping, SKF Geo, Sovcomflot (Cyprus) Ltd, SCF Management Services (St. Petersburg), its Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk subdivision, and SCF Management Services (Novorossiysk). Only Majoria Shipping and SCF Management Services (Cyprus) carry US OFAC badges; SKF Arktika (Asset Freeze, Natl Security) and Novoship (Natl Security only) carry other flags.

Many zero-flag subsidiaries are Liberia- or Cyprus-registered vessel-owning companies with GLEIF LEIs, so they can appear clean in an LEI-based supplier check even though they sit directly under an OFAC SDN parent.

subsidiaries_total counts 20 unique owned entities. The raw direction-out listing has 32 records: 20 'ownership' links sourced from sanctions lists, 11 duplicate 'parent_subsidiary' links from the Tradeverifyd Legacy Data Model for the same shipping companies, and 1 Corporate-registry link to ROSIMUSHCHESTVO, FKU.

ROSIMUSHCHESTVO, FKU (Federal Agency for State Property Management, 0 annotations, 1,455 affiliate links) appears in SCF's direction-out list, but its identity indicates it is the Russian state owner, so it is recorded under parents. This placement is an inference from the record's identity; the raw direction label says otherwise.

SCF's direction-in (parents) listing returned 17 records, but 12 of them are the same shipping and holding subsidiaries (Corporate registry, parent_subsidiary), suggesting the registry edges are stored in both directions. Those were not treated as parents. The other 5 are sanctions-list links with relationship_type 'unknown' and are in related_records.
No trade relationships exist for SCF in either direction (suppliers and buyers empty), nor for SOVCOMFLOT (UK) LTD.

annotated_relationship_paths (direction both, max_depth 2) returned an error: 'Entity d504c8e4-b908-40f9-ab33-e73824aa18ca not found in relationship graph'. flagged_paths is therefore empty; this reflects no trade-graph node, not an absence of risk.
Four subsidiaries (Sovcomflot (Cyprus) Ltd and three SCF Management Services offices) have country 'XX' (unknown) and no external IDs in Tradeverifyd.
The 'zero_flags' field on each subsidiary is an added convenience flag (true when annotation_count is 0).
